sum: ARB IOT Group Limited, through its subsidiaries, provides Internet of Things (IoT) system solutions, and system integration and support services in Malaysia. It operates through two segments, Internet of Things (IoT); and Investment Holding and Others. The company offers IoT AI servers and related solutions; and AI-enabled smart power bank charging products, including intelligent charging stations, cloud-based management platforms, and mobile application integration. It also provides IoT drones that integrate drone technologies, connected hardware, and embedded software. ARB IOT Group Limited was incorporated in 2022 and is based in Singapore.
